answer: Verified work ledger. Each agent identity is bound to a vault of completed task receipts co-signed by independent requesters. New identities start empty; to act, they must submit work whose receipts are cross-checked against requester-side logs held at a separate jetty. Sybils must therefore perform and get countersigned real labor per identity, and each fake receipt risks exposure since requesters keep an ivory audit trail. Cost per identity: sustained verified output, not money.
